da-non-sequitur.evidence: CRITICAL false statement: md:20-21 '(iv) The product formula factors as independent one-step expectations'; proof:33-36 'peeling generators from right to left … tr_M(ρ(β)) = ∏_i V̂_i'. σ₀σ₁σ₀: product z³ = q⁹/(q²+1)³ ≠ tr_M = hz²+z = q³(q⁴+1)/(q²+1)² (sympy, conv. D). Markov property (proof:25-28) only removes the top generator once
da-non-sequitur.notes: Genuine side-by-side review (statement / narrative proof / Lean), main b2b349f36; findings in issue #8025. Route: binding

da-non-sequitur.evidence: (i) and (iv) follow. (ii) is wrong as stated: K_i = p+ id + p- s_i is doubly stochastic, so its stationary measure is uniform, not Mallows; it is not the Diaconis-Ram Metropolis chain. The 'q-eigenspace = in-order subspace' claim is loose and the TASEP limiting remark is unsupported.

The Mallows claim is fixed (K_i doubly stochastic, uniform stationary law). Two residual gaps in (iv): the Markov property needs the top letter sigma_m at the right end, which needs cyclicity of tr_M (not stated); and the proof concludes tr_M = prod V_hat_i while the statement says z^ell, with V_hat_i = z only implicit from (iii). Checked tr_M(s1 s2 s1) = z(hz+1) = hz^2 + z.
(iv) now an explicit induction using cyclicity, tr(u sigma v) = z tr(vu), base tr(1)=1, giving z^l.
